### Confirmed orientation generalization for task-6178aad1
A later confirmed instance used background 3, scattered color-5 anchors, and a **vertical** 5-cell seed at column 3, rows 18–22: `[8,6,1,6,6]`. Replace every scattered 5 with this vertical motif, aligned so the third/center value `1` occupies the anchor cell (two rows above and below), preserve the original seed, and leave other cells/background unchanged.
